rationale: Three user-visible interaction defects share one delivery seam and are fixed together. render-assets-and-backends is crossed by core/view only: yoga_layout.cpp stops echoing an AtMost offer back as measured width -- AtMost is an upper bound that CSS resolves to min(max-content, available), so a soft-wrapping label reporting no intrinsic width made every auto-width ANCESTOR stretch instead of hug; the fix asks Label for max_content_width and clamps, leaving the Undefined and Exactly paths byte-identical. label.cpp gains the intrinsic-width accessor that makes that query possible. design-source-ingest is crossed by packages/pulp-react/prop-applier-paint.ts, which resolved hitSlop only for numbers and silently dropped string forms, so an authored touch target smaller than the finger that has to hit it stayed small; strings now resolve through the same dimension path as every other prop. visual-proof-harness is crossed only by ADDED detectors -- a mac platform harness plus hover-cursor delivery coverage -- which assert the cursor actually changes on a stationary hover rather than only on mousedown. No renderer, backend, font, asset or Skia pin changes; no fixture, snapshot or threshold is altered, and no existing detector's expectations move. Registered as watch-only so each family's coverage stays honest about a change that crossed its selector. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
